relevance_note: The paper describes five individually labelled LAD-I patients (mLAD1-4, sLAD) with age, sex, CD18 (ITGB2) mutations and clinical problems: "We evaluated five patients with LAD-I".
method_note: Read by hand; a short Python script assembled the JSON from my own transcription of Table 1 and supplementary Table S1 (ppat.1004698.s003.docx), checked against the tables. In scope: the five LAD-I patients mLAD1, mLAD2, mLAD3, mLAD4 and sLAD (labels as in the paper). The 12 healthy controls (H1-H12) are out of scope and get no rows; the paper states no single total cohort size (five LAD-I patients and 'twelve patients' healthy stated separately), so cohort_size_as_stated is null. Variants are in the Table 1 'CD18 Mutation' column; the gene is printed as CD18 there (the Introduction says 'CD18 (ITGB2) gene'). Variant strings are copied as printed, without c./p. prefixes; '850G(R)A' is printed with '(R)' (probably a converted arrow) and kept as is. mLAD2's 'Null allele (specific mutation unknown)' gets a row with variant_original_string 'not reported'. mLAD3's CD18 Mutation cell is empty; a row with 'not reported' was kept because the paper says all five were diagnosed by CD18 mutation. Variant type 'frameshift' only for C2070 del T, from 'fs transmembrane domain' in the same cell; sLAD's 'del exon 12,13' class not stated, left not reported. Zygosity left not reported except sLAD ('Homozygous'); the Methods group statement 'defined biallelic CD18 mutations' has no matching enum value and was not converted to compound heterozygous. Table 1 'Age' column taken as age at evaluation (years assumed from context, e.g. 'at the age of 13'). Supplementary Table S1 cells use ' / ' within ONE patient's row (one patient per row), so all stacked values in a row belong to that patient; no positional assignment across patients was needed (D-31 not triggered). The S1 antibiotic column is duplicated in the conversion. Table 1 'Missing Teeth' = 0 for mLAD1 and mLAD2 is not used to exclude tooth loss (a 0 cell counts as excluded only if defined; not defined), so tooth loss is not reported for them. 'Mild clinical phenotype' and 'Minimal secondary infections' (mLAD2, mLAD3) were not recorded as features. Folliculitis and Skin lesions were not mapped to 'skin or soft tissue infections'; Gastroenteritis (sLAD) was not mapped to gastrointestinal infections or colitis; only Cellulitis was mapped to skin or soft tissue infections. Periodontitis for mLAD1-4 comes from 'All five patients were diagnosed with generalized moderate to severe periodontitis' (group naming all five); caries excluded for all five from 'none of the patients had a single carious lesion' (named cohort). Gingivitis/periodontitis absence statements concern healthy controls only. Unnamed subsets (e.g. 'Representative of 3 LAD patients with tooth extractions') were not assigned to anyone. No contradictions found.
